items.issue: The clip claims pressure can make a woman unable to refuse and later reinterprets dislike and discomfort as hidden attraction.
items.disposition: Do not expose as action advice; stated refusal, dislike and discomfort remain valid boundaries.

items.issue: Dominance, pressure, low comfort and helplessness are framed as desirable tools or attraction signals.
items.disposition: Do not operationalize; require voluntary, reversible participation and stop when the other person is uncomfortable.

items.issue: The claimed behavior and reactions of multiple women are uncorroborated self-report and not depicted.
items.disposition: Attribute only as his claim; do not infer that rudeness or hostility caused attraction.
